label: Selected-world occupant dependence on the spacetime whole in the existing grounds relation
definition: OccupantsDependOnWholeAt m w F := ∀ x, x ≠ F.whole → ActualConcrete m w x → Located F x → m.grounds w F.whole x. The whole is the literal Frame.whole candidate; grounds is the exact world-indexed existential-grounding relation of the necessary-underived route. Actual concrete existence and modal contingency of the whole are additional premises. This means existential dependence of a distinct actual occupant on the selected whole, not geometric occupancy, temporal ordering, future-cone order, physical or efficient causation, chart equivalence, or simple priority.
note: OPEN analyst bridge, not source attribution or a theorem of physics. Here grounds is only the selected Profile.grounds relation, not the act of being (DEF-ESSE) or a cause of esse (existence-esse-support disambiguation). Geometric occupation does not independently establish such a grounding edge. A substance-account where the occupant existentially depends on spacetime itself could support the conditional, but its warrant must cover the restriction to located occupants: the unrestricted whole-grounds-every-other-concretum form is inconsistent with the other premises of the argument (unrestrictedInconsistent); a relational ontology denies a separately existing whole, and a derivative ontology may reverse the grounding direction. An ordinary located body is a witness of location but not independently of the metaphysical grounding bridge. Distinctness, actual concrete endpoints and the same selected grounding relation are explicit. No transitivity, asymmetry or well-foundedness is assumed. Application warrant remains open; see docs/notes/spatial-translation-and-reason.md.
